About Maryland Bathroom Refinishing

Experience you can see.

Maryland Bathroom Refinishing has been serving customers for more than 15 years. Our focus is straightforward: quality refinishing, careful surface preparation and customer satisfaction.

Instead of replacing a bathtub, shower, sink or tile installation that is still structurally usable, refinishing can provide a fresh appearance while avoiding a much larger renovation.

Questions

Frequently asked questions

What can you refinish?

We refinish bathtubs, showers, tub surrounds, wall tile and sinks. We also repair damaged porcelain and fiberglass.

Why refinish instead of replace?

Refinishing can refresh an existing surface without the demolition and replacement work involved in a larger bathroom renovation.

How long does the finish take to cure?

Many projects can be ready for use in approximately 24 hours, depending on the specific job, products and conditions. We’ll provide project-specific instructions.

Do you serve my Maryland location?

We serve customers throughout Maryland. Send your location and project details with your quote request so we can confirm availability.
